title: Analysis code for: VEXAS and Macrophage Activation Syndrome — clinical and multiomic approach of a unique hyperinflammatory clinical dyad
description: Analysis code and de-identified source data reproducing the cytokine, flow-cytometry, Olink Reveal proteomic and whole-exome summary results reported in the manuscript. Raw sequence data and the full proteomic plate export are not included; they are deposited under controlled access (see the manuscript's Data Availability statement).
